<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->

<!--
  A personal about section beside a portrait: a badge, the heading, a lead, then key facts and a list of
  specialities, or skill chips and expertise bars, and one or two links. Axes: layout (facts, skills),
  mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Skill, AboutMeLabels } from "./about-me.types";
  import type { Spec } from "./product-info.types";
  import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

  export type AboutMeProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    level?: 1 | 2;
    facts: Spec[];
    skills: Skill[];
    labels: AboutMeLabels;
    actions: LinkActions;
    layout?: "facts" | "skills";
    mediaSide?: "start" | "end";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Progress from "../primitives/form/progress.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    level = 1,
    facts,
    skills,
    labels,
    actions,
    layout = "facts",
    mediaSide = "start",
    tone = "default",
  }: AboutMeProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  heading={{ badge, level }}
  layout="split"
  media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
  tone={tone}
  density="default"
>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "facts")}
    <List tag="ul" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2" data-testid="facts">
      {#each facts as f (f.id)}
        <ListItem class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-0 p-4" data-testid="fact">
          <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {f.label}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {f.value}
          </Text>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="skills">
      {#each skills as s (s.id)}
        <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="skill">
          <Group gap="4" justify="between">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {s.label}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl(labels.level, s.level)}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <Progress value={(s.level == null ? undefined : String(s.level))} max="100" aria-label={s.label} />
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  <ActionGroup
    primary={actions.cta}
    primaryHref={actions.href}
    secondary={((actions.mode === "two") ? actions.secondary : undefined)}
    secondaryHref={actions.secondaryHref}
    align="start"
  />
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
